Next, in the center, are smartphones and PCs.

Next, I will explain how we are enhancing our production capability to support growing
demand in the AI industry.
To address growing AI demand, ramp up production of cutting edge products, and ensure a stable
supply, we have begun site preparation for FAB3 or K3 at the Kitakami plant.
K3 is planned to produce advanced node BixFlash with operations scheduled to begin in FY2029.
As we expand production capacity, we will first fully utilize available space at the
existing Y7 fab in Yokaiichi and K2 fab in Kitakami.
We will then expand K3 in phases calibrated to market demand growth.
The photo on the right provides an overview of the Kitakami plant, including the planned K3 construction site, together with the existing K1 and K2 fabs.

In addition, the absorption-type merger of Kioxia Iwate Corporation into Kioxia Corporation announced today is intended to achieve sustainable growth by strengthening manufacturing scale for cutting-edge flash memory products, as well as by improving management efficiency and reinforcing our business through the integrated deployment of management resources, including personnel and technologies, and the optimization of our business structure.
As such, alongside the Yokaichi plant, the Kitakami plant is an extremely important site in our business strategy.
We will continue to make strategic capital investments while carefully assessing demand trends,
steadily building the production base needed to meet growing demand in the AI era.
